reviews.text: I have a two-year-old house-swapped dog, who is my first dog. I bought a private lesson package twice and learned a lot about supporting my dog ​​when he was alone and guiding him. He also stopped pulling on the leash. I highly recommend it!

We had two private lessons with our little dachshund at Liisa Tikka's school in Masseter. Liisa was a really natural, friendly and approachable trainer. We got a lot of good and practical advice on training our dog during the private lessons, and they have been really useful to us in our everyday lives. We liked Liisa's way of guiding so much that we continued with our little dachshund to her Attention course. I can warmly recommend Liisa as a dog trainer!
We found great relief in our everyday lives with a lively puppy. Liisa gave us expert and practical advice and encouragement for training at home. I highly recommend her❤️
Experience with the SmartDog puppy test and the Nosework beginner course.

On the recommendation of a friend (who praised the place), I booked a course on the basics of hobby dog ​​training and I will definitely continue to take courses. I got a good starting point and practical tips and guidance for future hobbies.

A diverse range of courses and always nice, professional trainers. A dog school with a lot of experience, expertise, practicality and humor. Information and instructions are provided promptly. Dogs are considered as individuals and the training is always ethical.

The current ("new") training space is quite functional and the mats hold up well even under the most active paws. What I have especially appreciated in the courses is: well-planned lessons with enough training time and a suitable amount of theory; clear teaching; individual tips and feedback that focuses on what is essential for each dog - through successes; a considerate training environment also for those who 'need space'. I have participated in Masseter courses with both independent breed representatives and those who are more easily motivated, and even after years I can still admire Liisa Tika's dog reading skills. Credit!

We have taken several courses with our dog and we take a full-time class. The best thing from the beginning has been the qualified teachers, the dog-oriented approach and the good mood from both the dog and the owner's perspective. The group can accommodate all kinds of training, even without (competition) goals and you can be yourself. There is humor and laughter every time. I highly recommend it 🧡
Been practicing hooping in the masseter for over a year
Useful courses for everyday dog ​​life and hobbies. Top trainers!
Great, knowledgeable and dog-oriented approach❤️ I've taken a couple of courses here and it has brought not only joy but also relief to our lives. The best!

Competent instructors (I think everyone has been on the courses) and comfortable facilities. A very timid dog as a puppy has grown into a lively adult, especially with Liisa's support. Highly recommended.
